title: iOS screenshots for own Pluggy keys screens (budget-4ji): needs a tappable simulator (Simulator.app, idb or Appium)
notes:
Setup: iPhone 17 Pro sim (iOS 26.5) + Expo Go, Metro :8091 from the worktree, API :3100 auth-off on db budgetnew_wm8x (compose Postgres :55432, migrations+seed), CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY set, PLUGGY_BASE_URL -> fake Pluggy :3191 (POST /auth accepts only demo-client-id/demo-secret). Shared-pluggy-key feature off for dev user. Taps and typing via idb (fb-idb + idb-companion), navigation via exp://127.0.0.1:8091/--/<route> deep links. Paused banks seeded in SQL: Nubank (key_source shared) and Itau (key_source own, key_client_id old-client-id); the API paused both on list. The blue gear at top right in every shot is Expo Go's own dev-tools button, not the app.
Evidence (after fix): ev-cffb3f keys screen empty; ev-112a80 same, scrolled to the help and the 5-connection limit; ev-a001ac wrong pair rejected under the secret field (red border + message), submitted with ONE tap while the keyboard was up; ev-6433bf keys saved, client id shown, secret 'Saved (hidden)'; ev-fbd705 no keys + no shared key: tapping Connect on Linked banks lands on Your Pluggy keys with the connect banner; ev-8baad1 paused banks on the list (shared-key Nubank notice); ev-ca2e19 list scrolled to the own-key Itau notice; ev-c3cb37 Nubank page paused notice (shared keys); ev-88c62f Itau page paused notice (own keys no longer saved); ev-8d7ed1 empty Linked banks with Connect button uncovered.
Bugs found on iOS and fixed in 74531fe (before shots): ev-047f5e '+ Transaction' FAB covered 'Connect another bank' (and the keys help text): the phone shell now hides it on /connect-bank, /connection, /pluggy-keys (rail.logic showsTransactionFab + test). ev-3dd57f Linked banks phone row squeezed the paused notice into the narrow name column, truncating 'Nuba...' and hiding 'Itau' entirely: notice now spans the card under the row on phone, unclamped, pill wraps (connectBank.logic rowNoticeSlot + test). ev-1febad with the keyboard up the first tap on Save keys only dismissed the keyboard: ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps=handled. Checks: client tsc OK, eslint OK, bun test 1232 pass 0 fail.
Cleanup: Metro, API and fake Pluggy stopped, db budgetnew_wm8x dropped, simulator shut down, leases released. budget-postgres-1 (:55432) was already running before this task and was left up. Follow-ups filed: budget-vdhs (relaunching Expo Go loses the active budget, so every deep link first needed a tap on the budget), budget-fgdr (copy nit seen in ev-8d7ed1). Branch synced onto main; fix commit is now c82a4d5; client tsc/eslint/bun test (1232 pass) re-run after sync.
Approved by user. Merged to main as e301090. Five iOS screenshot sets captured in the simulator (ev-cffb3f, ev-112a80, ev-a001ac, ev-6433bf, ev-fbd705, ev-8baad1, ev-ca2e19, ev-c3cb37, ev-88c62f, ev-8d7ed1); fixed FAB covering the bank screens, paused notice squeezing bank rows, and the lost first tap on Save keys (c82a4d5). client tsc/eslint/bun test 1232 pass.
